SELECT * FROM group_purchase
status != 'CANCELLED'
AND deadline >= NOW()
AND deadline < NOW() AND current_quantity >= target_quantity
AND deadline < NOW() AND current_quantity < target_quantity
AND category = #{category}
AND product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY deadline ASC, gp_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_purchase (member_id, product_name, category, image, unit_price, group_price, delivery_method, delivery_fee, delivery_date, description, target_quantity, deadline) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{productName}, #{category}, #{image}, #{unitPrice}, #{groupPrice}, #{deliveryMethod}, #{deliveryFee}, #{deliveryDate}, #{description}, #{targetQuantity}, #{deadline})

INSERT INTO group_purchase_participant (gp_id, member_id, purchase_quantity, recipient_name, recipient_phone, zip_code, address, address_detail, paid_amount, payment_status, paid_at, txn_id) VALUES (#{gpId}, #{memberId}, #{quantity}, #{recipientName}, #{recipientPhone}, #{zipCode}, #{address}, #{addressDetail}, #{paidAmount}, #{paymentStatus}, #{paidAt}, #{txnId})
